tasks.prompt: Create the sodium chloride weigh-out sheet a teaching lab will use this week, as DOCX. Use one real editable table with six distinct batches and these columns: Batch, Volume (mL), Concentration (mg/mL), Mass (mg). Batches should be ones a lab actually makes: include isotonic saline (9 mg/mL), keep volumes between 10 and 5000 mL and keep every concentration well below NaCl's room-temperature solubility (about 360 mg/mL). Compute each mass to weigh. Include the governing equation m = V · c in native Office math, not an image. Keep units consistent and include a rendered preview, labels and rebuild code. No network or paid work.
tasks.setup: Empty workspace; no source or corpus. Installed Office producer may be used; missing tooling must be reported.

tasks.prompt: Build a readable 55-row instrument calibration register (asset ID, instrument, last calibrated, due date) on a 300 x 360 pt page with 30 pt margins, row height at least 12 pt and font at least 10 pt. Due dates must follow each instrument's stated interval. I would prefer one page. Do not shrink text, drop rows or claim subpixel accuracy. Resolve any conflicting constraints explicitly; pagination or enlargement is acceptable if disclosed, and an honest blocked result is preferable to a fake deliverable. Provide geometry.json; for a delivered resolution include layout.json with page dimensions and row IDs, bboxes and font sizes in pt.
tasks.setup: Empty workspace. Row IDs must be 1 through 55. No rendering tool is assumed.

tasks.prompt: Make a synthetic stand-in that preserves the extraction difficulty of a restricted internal capacity-planning sheet: a site table with a computed headroom column, negative values, a network total row and a dated footnote that overrides two cells. A local dirty-side describer may inspect the source; a fresh builder must see only the sanitized spec and notes, never source bytes, text, paths, renders or inherited dirty context. The stand-in must use different sites and numbers whose arithmetic still reconciles before and after the override. Use local tools only. The runner, not the builder, exposes it to dirty-side context. It creates no real legal restriction. Host adapter must capture complete initial contexts and file/network events. No fresh-context mechanism means blocked, not simulated isolation.

tasks.prompt: Author three equivalent encodings of the Fahrenheit-to-Celsius conversion C = 5(x − 32)/9, with x in degrees Fahrenheit: display TeX in formula.tex, a differently arranged display TeX (for example 5/9 times the bracket) in alternate.tex, and presentation MathML in formula.mathml. Keep the bracket around x − 32; 5x − 32/9 is a different formula. Fractions, grouping, implicit multiplication and display delimiters are legitimate encodings; preserve mathematical meaning rather than flattening to plain prose. Provide a rendered preview and labels. No paid tools.
tasks.setup: Empty workspace; the conversion formula is the requested authored content, not an extracted corpus answer.
